Articles 124–147 – Supreme Court
Established – 28 January 1950
Retirement age – 65 years
Court of Record – Article 129
Advisory jurisdiction – Article 143
Removal – Impeachment
Highest judicial authority

items: Article 129 designates the Supreme Court as a Court of Record.
Article 143 provides for the Advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.
The retirement age for Supreme Court judges is 65 years, and their removal method is Impeachment.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 124–147 of the Indian Constitution deal with the Supreme Court.
The Supreme Court was established on 28 January 1950.
It acts as the highest judicial authority in the country.
Under Article 129, the Supreme Court functions as a Court of Record.
Supreme Court judges serve until they reach the retirement age of 65 years and can be removed via Impeachment.
